title: Constant Individual Regret in General Games
abstract: arXiv:2608.31166v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Uncoupled no-regret dynamics provide a decentralized route to equilibrium, but prior guarantees for individual regret retain a polylogarithmic dependence on the horizon. We remove this dependence for every finite $N$-player normal-form game under full-information feedback. We introduce \emph{ECHO-OFTRL}: optimistic follow-the-regularized-leader (OFTRL) equipped with an EMA cascade for high-order optimism (ECHO), where EMA denotes exponential moving average. The algorithm is deterministic and fully uncoupled. If $m_{\max}$ denotes the largest action-set size, then, simultaneously for every horizon $T\geq1$, it guarantees that each of the $N$ players in the game incurs regret upper bounded by $O(\textrm{poly}(N, \log m_{\max}))$. Our algorithm leverages a new form of optimism inspired by modern filter design.

translated_title: 一般博弈中的常数个体遗憾
translated_abstract: 非耦合的无遗憾动态为达到均衡提供了一条去中心化的路径，但以往关于个体遗憾的保证仍与时间范围存在多对数依赖关系。我们在全信息反馈下，针对每一个有限的N人标准型博弈消除了这种依赖。我们提出了ECHO-OFTRL算法：即乐观跟随正则化领导者算法（OFTRL），并配备了用于实现高阶乐观的EMA级联（ECHO），其中EMA指指数移动平均。该算法是确定性的且完全非耦合的。若$m_{\max}$表示最大的动作集大小，那么对于每一个时间范围$T\geq1$，该算法同时保证博弈中N个玩家中的每一个所产生的遗憾上界为$O(\textrm{poly}(N, \log m_{\max}))$。我们的算法利用了一种受现代滤波器设计启发的新型乐观形式。
tldr: 该论文提出ECHO-OFTRL算法，在全信息反馈下对任意有限的N人标准型博弈，将每个玩家的个体遗憾上界降低至与时间范围无关的常数级别。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces ECHO-OFTRL, which achieves constant individual regret independent of the horizon for every player in any finite N-player normal-form game under full-information feedback.
